requiredScope: The fixed required language and runtime comparison scope remains in force.

Expression/BuiltinCast.role: An explicit conversion of an existing signed integer, Boolean, typed text or NULL to built-in text.
Expression/BuiltinCast.structure: A resolved text destination and a checked operand of the admitted value closure.
Expression/BuiltinCast.conditions: The target is the scalar built-in text type. A known text operand can keep its type in this domain. Conversion from that text into a numeric or Boolean type requires its own checked role.
Expression/BuiltinCast.meaning: The exact signed decimal spelling represents an integer, true or false represents the Boolean value, the contents of a text value are unchanged, and NULL keeps its null state while acquiring text metadata.
Expression/BuiltinCast.sql: Emit the checked operand with an explicit CAST to pg_catalog.text.

Binding/Parameter.role: A positional input with the built-in text role.
Binding/Parameter.structure: One native one-based ordinal and the explicit text input type.
Binding/Parameter.conditions: The owning root checks a contiguous signature and a consistent input type for each reused position. The observer binds valid UTF-8 text or NULL.
Binding/Parameter.meaning: Every reference to the same position consumes the same input. The first resolving occurrence fixes its native type.
Binding/Parameter.sql: Emit the explicit text cast on the same numbered native marker.

externalInterpretation: Use the same native release, UTF-8 SQL settings, resolved declared column types and text bindings. An observer prepares original and emitted SQL without supplying inferred input types.
observations: Exact output names, positions, native text metadata and value bytes
Signed decimal outputs, both Boolean values and typed NULL
Native ordered prepared parameter OIDs and NULL versus empty text
Exact positional correspondence in repeated and reordered projections

finite.completeness: Independently recover the literal operand role, binding vector and result layout from the emitted graph. Require all twenty literal and fifteen parameter identities.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary native integer limits, text bytes, nested identity casts, widths and repeated or distinct bind references.

analysis: Explicit numeric, Boolean and NULL conversions preserve the resolved text target.
A typed text operand stays text through an outer text cast.
Native text marker syntax resolves its input and output OID.
Mixed text and int4 positional inputs preserve their original input order.
Two independently typed casts of a reused text position consume the same single binding.
A complete declaration context resolves an unqualified text target to the same native marker type.
negative: A closed root uses the same input position with distinct direct input types.
A root contains a hole in its text binding signature.
A text value is offered to a cast requiring the existing numeric or Boolean input role.
faults: Emit a different native text type.
Replace a typed NULL with empty text.
Change the inferred input OID while preserving the output text.

evidence.P01: Observe resolved type, operand domain and exact native input positions.
evidence.P02: Verify role closure and checked signature rules before publication.
evidence.P03: Retain only typed operands and binding coordinates.
evidence.P04: Compose each operand, cast, slot and outer projection by their explicit rules.
evidence.P05: Connect immutable values to the staged package and checked PHP storage.
evidence.P06: Compare native typed values and inferred signatures for original and emitted statements.
evidence.Q01: Apply typed role and signature negatives and exact code-shape checks.
evidence.Q02: Require every fixed finite and exploration identity.
evidence.Q03: Exercise nested casts and repeated bindings.
evidence.Q04: Compare independent expected text data, NULL, metadata and input OIDs.
evidence.Q05: Bind the relevant PHP source and selected run and replay tools by digest.

open: General conversion from text into other native types, text columns, text functions and collations require further evidence.
trust: Read-only native observer with separately measured input signatures
Reviewed semantic oracle and exact distributed PHP
faultExplanation: The mandatory NULL fault changes the value. Dropping the cast alone can yield the same native text output through the SELECT default.
